questions.question: What is the lowest form of the fraction (72)/(96) obtained by cancelling the HCF of the numerator and denominator?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

HCF of 72 and 96 = 24

⇒ 72 ÷ 24 = 3, 96 ÷ 24 = 4

**∴ Answer = 3/4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction = 72/96

**Formula used:**

Lowest form = Divide numerator and denominator by HCF

**Calculation:**

⇒ HCF of 72 and 96 = 24

⇒ 72 ÷ 24 = 3

⇒ 96 ÷ 24 = 4

⇒ Fraction = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Concept

Highest Common Factor is the greatest number dividing both values

Simplification

Divide numerator and denominator by same number

Lowest Form

Fraction is simplest when HCF = 1

Quick Tip

Break numbers into prime factors to find HCF easily

questions.question: In a quadrilateral IJKL, ∠I = 36° and ∠J = 44°. The bisectors of ∠K and ∠L meet at Z. What is the measure of ∠LZK?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of any two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is equal to half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠LZK = (∠I + ∠J) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠LZK = (36° + 44°) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠LZK = 80° ÷ 2 = 40°

**∴ The correct answer is 40°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite directions at speeds of 72 km/hr and 108 km/hr, respectively. The length of the first train is 150 m, and the length of the second train is 200 m. How much time will they take to cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ Relative speed = 72 + 108 = 180 km/hr

Convert to m/s ⇒ 180 × (5/18) = 50 m/s

Total length = 150 + 200 = 350 m

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 350 ÷ 50 = 7 sec

**∴ Answer = 7 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speeds = 72 km/hr and 108 km/hr

Lengths = 150 m and 200 m

**Formula used:**

Relative speed (opposite) = sum of speeds

Time = Total length ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 72 + 108 = 180 km/hr

⇒ Convert to m/s: 180 × (5/18) = 50 m/s

⇒ Total length = 150 + 200 = 350 m

⇒ Time = 350 ÷ 50 = 7 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 7 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ add speeds

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Crossing Concept

Total distance = sum of lengths

Quick Tip

Always convert speed to same unit before dividing

questions.question: Two trains are travelling towards each other on parallel tracks, 9660 kilometres apart. Train A initially travels at 80 km/hr, and Train B initially travels at 60 km/hr. If Train A's speed is reduced by 10% and Train B's speed is increased by 10%, what is the ratio of the time taken for the trains to meet initially to the time taken after their speed adjustments?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time ∝ 1 / (relative speed)

Initial relative speed = 80 + 60 = 140

New speeds ⇒ A = 80 × 0.9 = 72, B = 60 × 1.1 = 66

New relative speed = 72 + 66 = 138

Ratio of time = inverse of speed ratio

= 138 : 140 = 69 : 70

**∴ Answer = 69 : 70**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance same in both cases

Initial speeds: 80 km/hr and 60 km/hr

After change: 72 km/hr and 66 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial relative speed = 80 + 60 = 140

⇒ New relative speed = 72 + 66 = 138

⇒ Time ratio = (D/140) : (D/138)

⇒ = 138 : 140

⇒ = 69 : 70

**∴ The correct answer is 69 : 70.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add

Time-Speed Relation

For same distance, time ∝ 1/speed

Percentage Change

Decrease 10% ⇒ ×0.9, Increase 10% ⇒ ×1.1

Quick Tip

Use inverse ratio for time comparison

questions.question: {If } tan theta = (1)/(2), { then } (cos theta - sin theta)/(sin theta + cos theta) { is equal to :}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take common cosθ:

(cosθ − sinθ)/(sinθ + cosθ)

= cosθ(1 − tanθ) / cosθ(tanθ + 1)

= (1 − tanθ)/(1 + tanθ)

Put tanθ = 1/2:

= (1 − 1/2)/(1 + 1/2) = (1/2)/(3/2) = 1/3

**∴ Answer = 1/3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tanθ = 1/2

**Formula used:**

tanθ = sinθ / cosθ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let sinθ = 1k, cosθ = 2k

⇒ Substitute:

(cosθ − sinθ)/(sinθ + cosθ)

= (2k − 1k)/(1k + 2k)

= k / 3k = 1/3

**∴ The correct answer is 1/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Identity

tanθ = sinθ / cosθ

Simplification Trick

Take common cosθ to convert into tan form

Alternative Approach

Assume sinθ and cosθ proportional to tan ratio

Quick Tip

Convert expression fully in terms of tanθ for easy substitution

questions.question: A running track consists of two straight parallel segments, each 120 m long, connected at both ends by semicircular arcs. The inner perimeter of the track is 504 m. If the track has a uniform width of 18 m throughout, find the outer perimeter (in m, rounded off to the nearest tens) of the track. Take π = 22/7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Inner perimeter = 2 × straight + curved

⇒ 504 = 2×120 + curved ⇒ curved = 504 − 240 = 264

Curved = circumference of circle ⇒ 2πr = 264

⇒ r = 264 / (2π) = 264 / (44/7) = 42 m

Outer radius = 42 + 18 = 60 m

Outer curved length = 2π × 60 = (44/7) × 60 ≈ 377.14

Total outer perimeter = 240 + 377.14 ≈ 617

Rounded to nearest tens ⇒ **620 m**

**∴ Answer = 620 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Straight parts = 120 m each

Inner perimeter = 504 m

Width = 18 m

**Formula used:**

Perimeter = 2 × straight + circumference of circle

Circumference = 2πr

**Calculation:**

⇒ 504 = 240 + 2πr

⇒ 2πr = 264

⇒ r = 42 m

⇒ Outer radius = 42 + 18 = 60 m

⇒ Outer curved length = 2π × 60 = 377.14

⇒ Total outer perimeter = 240 + 377.14 ≈ 617

⇒ Rounded ≈ 620 m

**∴ The correct answer is 620 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Track Structure

Two straight lines + two semicircles = one full circle

Width Effect

Only radius changes; straight lengths remain same

Key Idea

Find inner radius first, then add width

Rounding

Round final answer to nearest tens

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 94, 59, 46, 34, 15, 55, 89, 98 and 68 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 60.

Net deviation = (+34) + (−1) + (−14) + (−26) + (−45) + (−5) + (+29) + (+38) + (+8) = +18

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average Deviation = 60 + 2 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 94, 59, 46, 34, 15, 55, 89, 98, 68

Total number of observations (N) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 
 
 94
 
 59
 
 46
 
 34
 
 15
 
 55
 
 89
 
 98
 
 68
 
 Sum of 9 Observations = 558
 
• 
 

 
 Mean = 62
 Calculation: 558 ÷ 9 = 62

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 94 + 59 + 46 + 34 + 15 + 55 + 89 + 98 + 68

⇒ Sum of observations = 558

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 558 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when different groups have different counts. Formula: (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂) ÷ (N₁ + N₂).

Combined Average

When combining multiple sets, the overall average is the sum of all elements divided by the total number of elements.

Deviation Method

Averages can be found by choosing an assumed mean, finding the net deviation of all values, and adding (net deviation ÷ N) to the assumed mean.
</p

questions.question: A spherical water tank has a radius of 21 metres. Calculate the volume (in m³ ) of water it can hold. (Use pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The result must be a multiple of 11 because the volume formula involves π (22 ÷ 7).

Also, the volume formula contains r³ ÷ 3. Since r = 21 (a multiple of 3), the result must be a multiple of 9.

Check the options for divisibility by 9 (Sum of digits must be a multiple of 9):

⇒ 38,800 → Sum = 19 (Not divisible) | 30,800 → Sum = 11 (Not divisible) | 30,808 → Sum = 19 (Not divisible)

⇒ 38,808 → Sum = 27 (Divisible by 9). It is also divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 38,808 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the spherical tank (r) = 21 m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere (V) = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³

 
 

 

 
• 
 
 r = 21 m
 Spherical Water Tank

**Calculations:**

⇒ V = (4 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 21 × 21 × 21

⇒ V = (88 ÷ 21) × 21 × 21 × 21

⇒ V = 88 × 21 × 21

⇒ V = 88 × 441

⇒ V = 38808

**∴ The correct answer is 38,808 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total curved surface area of a complete sphere is calculated using 4 × π × r². A sphere has no edges or flat faces.

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Its volume formula is exactly half, given by (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

It includes both the curved surface area (2 × π × r²) and the flat circular base area (π × r²), making the total area 3 × π × r².
</p

questions.question: Due to a water crisis, 40% of the initial population left the village and 35% of the remaining left the town to pursue a job. If presently 2340 people inhabit the village, what is the ratio of initial population to present population?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let initial population = 100

After 40% leave ⇒ remaining = 60

Then 35% leave ⇒ remaining = 65% of 60 = 39

Final = 39

Ratio (initial : present) = 100 : 39

**∴ Answer = 100 : 39**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40% left initially

35% of remaining left

Present population = 2340

**Formula used:**

Remaining = Initial × (1 − % decrease)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial population = x

⇒ After 40% leave ⇒ remaining = 0.6x

⇒ After 35% leave ⇒ remaining = 0.6x × 0.65 = 0.39x

⇒ 0.39x = 2340

⇒ Ratio (initial : present) = x : 2340 = 1 : 0.39

⇒ = 100 : 39

**∴ The correct answer is 100 : 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Multiply remaining factors: (1 − p/100)

Net Factor

0.6 × 0.65 = 0.39

Key Insight

Final = 39% of initial

Quick Tip

Assume base 100 for easy ratio

questions.question: If the ratio of the mode and median of a certain data is 11 : 9, then find the ratio of its mean and median.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Mode = 11 units and Median = 9 units.

Using the empirical formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ 11 = 3 × 9 − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = 27 − 11 = 16 ⇒ Mean = 8 units.

Ratio of Mean to Median = 8 : 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Mode and Median = 11 : 9

**Formula Used:**

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

 
 Empirical Distribution Scale

 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Mean
 Median
 Mode

 
 8x
 9x
 11x

 
 

 Diff = x

 
 

 Diff = 2x

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Mode = 11x and Median = 9x

⇒ Substituting the given values into the formula:

⇒ 11x = 3 × 9x − 2 × Mean

⇒ 11x = 27x − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = 27x − 11x

⇒ 2 × Mean = 16x

⇒ Mean = 8x

⇒ Required Ratio = Mean : Median = 8x : 9x = 8 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, Mean, Median, and Mode are connected by the relation: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**. This indicates the degree of asymmetry in a probability distribution.

Measures of Central Tendency

**Mean:** The arithmetic average of all observations.
**Median:** The middle value when the complete data set is arranged in numerical order.
**Mode:** The observation that appears the maximum number of times in the set.
</p

questions.question: {If } x = sqrt{10} + 3, { then the value of } x³ - (1)/(x³) { is:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given x = √10 + 3. Since (√10)² − 3² = 10 − 9 = 1, we can directly write 1/x = √10 − 3.

⇒ x − 1/x = (√10 + 3) − (√10 − 3) = 6.

Using the algebraic shortcut: If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

⇒ Required value = 6³ + 3 × 6 = 216 + 18 = 234.

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = √10 + 3

**Formula Used:**

a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1/x = 1 ÷ (√10 + 3)

Rationalising the denominator by multiplying numerator and denominator by (√10 − 3):

⇒ 1/x = (√10 − 3) ÷ [(√10 + 3)(√10 − 3)]

⇒ 1/x = (√10 − 3) ÷ (10 − 9)

⇒ 1/x = √10 − 3

Now, finding the value of (x − 1/x):

⇒ x − 1/x = (√10 + 3) − (√10 − 3)

⇒ x − 1/x = 6

Substituting a = x and b = 1/x in the identity formula:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 6³ + 3 × 1 × 6

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 216 + 18

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 234

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for x + 1/x

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2, and x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Algebraic Identity for x − 1/x

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2, and x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Rationalization Rule

If x = √a + √b and the difference of their squares is 1 (i.e., a − b = 1), then 1/x = √a − √b. This allows for quick calculation of reciprocals without explicitly rationalising.

Difference of Squares

The formula a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b) is essential for rationalising denominator expressions containing square roots.
</p

questions.question: Ajay, Maya and Mohan started a business in partnership investing in the ratio of 11 : 16 : 6, respectively. At the end of the year, they earned a profit of ₹69,300, which is 70% of their total investment. How much did Maya invest (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit is 70% of total investment

⇒ Total Investment = 69300 ÷ 0.7 = 99000

⇒ Ratio sum = 11 + 16 + 6 = 33, so 1 part = 99000 ÷ 33 = 3000

⇒ Maya's investment = 16 × 3000

**∴ Answer = 48000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of investments = 11 : 16 : 6, Profit = 69300 (which is 70% of total investment)

**Formula used:**

Profit = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total Investment

**Calculation:**

⇒ (70 ÷ 100) × Total Investment = 69300

⇒ Total Investment = 69300 × 100 ÷ 70 = 99000

⇒ Total ratio = 11 + 16 + 6 = 33

⇒ Maya’s investment = (16 ÷ 33) × 99000

⇒ Maya’s investment = 16 × 3000 = 48000

**∴ The correct answer is 48000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Concept

Profit is shared in the ratio of Capital × Time invested.

Percentage Conversion

x% = x ÷ 100. Used to convert percentage into fraction.

Ratio Distribution

Individual share = (Part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount.

questions.question: Mohan is twice as old as Suresh. Four years ago, the sum of their ages was 40. What is the present age of Suresh?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let present age of Suresh = x, so Mohan = 2x

4 years ago: (x − 4) + (2x − 4) = 40

⇒ 3x − 8 = 40 ⇒ 3x = 48

⇒ x = 16

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mohan is twice as old as Suresh. Four years ago, their total age was 40.

**Formula used:**

Present age − years ago = past age

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present age of Suresh = x

⇒ Present age of Mohan = 2x

⇒ 4 years ago, Suresh = x − 4 and Mohan = 2x − 4

⇒ (x − 4) + (2x − 4) = 40

⇒ 3x − 8 = 40

⇒ 3x = 48

⇒ x = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation in One Variable

Equations like ax + b = c are solved by isolating x step by step.

Age Problems Concept

Use present age as variable and adjust for past/future by adding or subtracting years.

Ratio in Ages

If one person is twice another, represent as 2x and x for simplicity.

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends Rupesh and Manjit, are in the ratio 5 : 8, respectively, and each of them saves ₹84,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 1 : 3, find the monthly income of Rupesh (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio = 5x : 8x, Expenditure ratio = y : 3y

Savings = Income − Expenditure = 84000 for both

⇒ 5x − y = 84000 and 8x − 3y = 84000

Subtract: (8x − 3y) − (5x − y) = 0 ⇒ 3x − 2y = 0 ⇒ y = 1.5x

Put in first: 5x − 1.5x = 84000 ⇒ 3.5x = 84000 ⇒ x = 24000

**∴ Answer = 120000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio of Rupesh and Manjit = 5 : 8, Savings each = 84000, Expenditure ratio = 1 : 3

**Formula used:**

Saving = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let incomes = 5x and 8x

⇒ Let expenditures = y and 3y

⇒ For Rupesh: 5x − y = 84000

⇒ For Manjit: 8x − 3y = 84000

⇒ Subtract equations:

⇒ (8x − 3y) − (5x − y) = 84000 − 84000

⇒ 3x − 2y = 0 ⇒ y = 1.5x

⇒ Substitute in first equation:

⇒ 5x − 1.5x = 84000

⇒ 3.5x = 84000

⇒ x = 24000

⇒ Rupesh’s income = 5x = 5 × 24000 = 120000

**∴ The correct answer is 120000.**

Income–Expenditure Relation

Saving = Income − Expenditure. This is the key equation for such problems.

Solving Linear Equations

Two equations with two variables can be solved using substitution or elimination.

If ratio is a : b, values can be taken as ax and bx for simplification.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹8,800 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:

The effective Compound Interest rate for 2 years at 10% per annum is calculated using the successive percentage formula:

Effective Rate = 10% + 10% + (10 × 10) / 100 % = 21%

Amount = Principal × (100% + Effective Rate)

Amount = 121% of ₹8,800 = 1.21 × 8800 = 10648

Effective Rate Method

The effective Compound Interest rate for 2 years at R% per annum can be directly found using the formula: Net Rate = R + R + (R×R)/100 %.

Difference between CI and SI for 2 Years

For a sum P at a rate R% per annum, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for exactly 2 years is calculated as: D = P(R/100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate is halved to R/2% and the time periods are doubled to 2T. The resulting formula becomes: A = P(1 + R/200)²T.

Quarterly Compounding

When interest is compounded quarterly, the rate is divided by 4 (R/4) and the total number of periods is multiplied by 4 (4T). Formula: A = P(1 + R/400)⁴T.

questions.question: ₹6,129 is divided among P, Q and R in such a way that if ₹71, ₹38 and ₹20 is deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 14:3:8. Find the difference between the original shares of Q and R.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After deduction ratio = 14 : 3 : 8, so values = 14x, 3x, 8x

Original shares = (14x + 71), (3x + 38), (8x + 20)

Total = 6129 ⇒ 25x + 129 = 6129

⇒ 25x = 6000 ⇒ x = 240

Q = 3x + 38 = 758, R = 8x + 20 = 1940

**∴ Answer = 1182**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 6129, deductions = 71, 38, 20, ratio after deduction = 14 : 3 : 8

**Formula used:**

Total share = Sum of individual shares

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let remaining shares be 14x, 3x, 8x

⇒ Original shares:

⇒ P = 14x + 71

⇒ Q = 3x + 38

⇒ R = 8x + 20

⇒ Total = (14x + 71) + (3x + 38) + (8x + 20)

⇒ 25x + 129 = 6129

⇒ 25x = 6000

⇒ x = 240

⇒ Q = 3x + 38 = 720 + 38 = 758

⇒ R = 8x + 20 = 1920 + 20 = 1940

⇒ Difference = 1940 − 758 = 1182

**∴ The correct answer is 1182.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Adjustment Concept

When deductions are applied, reverse them by adding back to get original values.

Linear Equation Formation

Total sum helps form one equation to find the common multiplier.

Difference Calculation

Difference = Larger value − Smaller value after computing individual shares.

questions.question: A money box contains only ₹2 coins and ₹5 coins. There are 20 coins in total, and their combined value is ₹70. How many ₹2 coins are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all 20 coins are ₹2 ⇒ total = 40

Actual total = 70 ⇒ extra = 30

Each ₹5 coin adds extra 3 (5 − 2)

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 30 ÷ 3 = 10

⇒ Number of ₹2 coins = 20 − 10 = 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total coins = 20, Total value = 70, coin values = 2 and 5

**Formula used:**

Total value = (Number of coins × value of each coin)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number of ₹2 coins = x

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 20 − x

⇒ Total value equation:

⇒ 2x + 5(20 − x) = 70

⇒ 2x + 100 − 5x = 70

⇒ −3x + 100 = 70

⇒ −3x = −30

⇒ x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Approach

Assume all items are of lower value, then adjust using difference to find higher value count.

Linear Equation Method

Form equation using total number and total value to solve unknown quantity.

Difference Technique

Extra value divided by per-unit difference gives count of higher value items.

questions.question: The number of prime numbers between 472 and 486 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find prime numbers, check only odd numbers that do not end in 5: 473, 477, 479, 481, and 483.

Apply simple divisibility rules: 477 and 483 are divisible by 3 (digit sums are 18 and 15).

Apply alternating sum for 11: 473 → 4 − 7 + 3 = 0, so it is divisible by 11.

For 481, test prime numbers > 11: 481 = 13 × 37.

The only remaining number, 479, is not divisible by any prime up to √486 (≈ 22).

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The range of numbers: strictly between 472 and 486.

**Concept Used:**

To verify if a number N is prime, we only need to check its divisibility by all prime numbers up to √N.

**Calculation:**

⇒ The numbers between 472 and 486 are 473, 474, 475, 476, 477, 478, 479, 480, 481, 482, 483, 484, and 485.

⇒ Even numbers and numbers ending in 5 are not prime, which immediately eliminates 474, 475, 476, 478, 480, 482, 484, and 485.

⇒ We only need to check the remaining odd numbers: 473, 477, 479, 481, and 483.

⇒ For 473: 4 − 7 + 3 = 0, so it is a multiple of 11 (473 = 11 × 43).

⇒ For 477: The sum of the digits is 4 + 7 + 7 = 18, making it a multiple of 3.

⇒ For 481: Dividing by prime numbers gives 481 ÷ 13 = 37, so it is not prime.

⇒ For 483: The sum of the digits is 4 + 8 + 3 = 15, making it a multiple of 3.

⇒ For 479: We must check its divisibility by primes up to √479 ≈ 21.8 (i.e., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19).

⇒ 479 is not divisible by any of these primes, so 479 is a prime number.

⇒ Therefore, there is exactly 1 prime number in the given range.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Definition

A natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and the number itself.

Prime Number Test Rule

To manually check if N is a prime, find an integer K ≥ √N. If N is not divisible by any prime number ≤ K, then N is mathematically confirmed as a prime number.

Co-prime Numbers

Two integers are co-prime (or mutually prime) if their highest common factor (HCF) is strictly 1. They do not necessarily have to be prime numbers themselves (e.g., 8 and 15 are co-prime).

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 24 days, B in 18 days and C in 36 days. All of them started working together. After working for 4 days, A left the work. B and C continued, but B left 3 days before the completion of the work. How long (in days) did the work last?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM = 72 ⇒ A = 3, B = 4, C = 2 units/day

First 4 days work = (3 + 4 + 2) × 4 = 36 units

Remaining = 72 − 36 = 36 units

Let total days = x ⇒ Last 3 days only C works

⇒ Work: (B + C)(x − 7) + C × 3 = 36

⇒ 6(x − 7) + 6 = 36 ⇒ 6x − 42 + 6 = 36 ⇒ 6x = 72 ⇒ x = 12

**∴ Answer = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = 24 days, B = 18 days, C = 36 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Rate × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Take total work = LCM(24,18,36) = 72 units

⇒ A's efficiency = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 units/day

⇒ B's efficiency = 72 ÷ 18 = 4 units/day

⇒ C's efficiency = 72 ÷ 36 = 2 units/day

⇒ In first 4 days, all work together:

⇒ Work done = (3 + 4 + 2) × 4 = 9 × 4 = 36 units

⇒ Remaining work = 72 − 36 = 36 units

⇒ Let total time = x days

⇒ After A leaves, remaining time = x − 4

⇒ B leaves 3 days before end ⇒ B works for (x − 7) days

⇒ C works for (x − 4) days

⇒ Work by B and C:

⇒ B's work = 4(x − 7)

⇒ C's work = 2(x − 4)

⇒ Total work equation:

⇒ 4(x − 7) + 2(x − 4) = 36

⇒ 4x − 28 + 2x − 8 = 36

⇒ 6x − 36 = 36

⇒ 6x = 72

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time. Higher efficiency means faster work rate.

LCM Method

Take total work as LCM of individual times to simplify calculations.

Work Distribution

Total work = Sum of (Efficiency × Time) for each worker.

questions.question:
A retailer offers the following discount schemes for buyers on an article. Which scheme will be the LEAST beneficial to the customer?

i. A discount of 48%.

ii. A discount of 31% followed by a discount of 44%.

iii. Successive discounts of 32% and 21%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare effective discounts:

i: 48%

ii: 31% + 44% − (31 × 44 ÷ 100) = 75 − 13.64 = 61.36%

iii: 32% + 21% − (32 × 21 ÷ 100) = 53 − 6.72 = 46.28%

Least discount = 46.28%

**∴ Answer = Scheme iii**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes: 48%, (31% then 44%), (32% then 21%)

**Formula used:**

Final Price = MP × (1 − d1) × (1 − d2)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let MP = 100

⇒ Scheme i: SP = 100 − 48 = 52 ⇒ Discount = 48%

⇒ Scheme ii: SP = 100 × 0.69 × 0.56 = 38.64 ⇒ Discount = 61.36%

⇒ Scheme iii: SP = 100 × 0.68 × 0.79 = 53.72 ⇒ Discount = 46.28%

⇒ Least discount = 46.28%

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme iii.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Effective Discount = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100)

Customer Benefit

Higher discount means more benefit to the customer.

Shortcut Tip

Always compare effective discounts instead of calculating final prices separately.

questions.question: Simplify: sqrt{2} + (1)/(sqrt{2)} + (1)/(2+sqrt{2)} - (1)/(2-sqrt{2)}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: 1/(a+b) − 1/(a−b) = −2b/(a² − b²)

⇒ Here a = 2, b = √2

⇒ 1/(2+√2) − 1/(2−√2) = −2√2/(4 − 2) = −√2

Now expression = √2 + 1/√2 − √2

⇒ = 1/√2

**∴ Answer = (1)/(sqrt{2)} **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√2 + 1/√2 + 1/(2+√2) − 1/(2−√2)

**Concept Used:**

Rationalization and BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rationalize 1/(2+√2): (2−√2)/(4−2) = (2−√2)/2

⇒ Rationalize 1/(2−√2): (2+√2)/(4−2) = (2+√2)/2

⇒ Expression = √2 + 1/√2 + (2−√2)/2 − (2+√2)/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 + [2−√2 − 2 − √2]/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 + (−2√2)/2

⇒ = √2 + 1/√2 − √2

⇒ = 1/√2

**∴ The correct answer is (1)/(sqrt{2)} .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization

Multiply numerator and denominator by conjugate to remove root from denominator.

Conjugate Identity

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

Simplification Tip

Combine similar radical terms to reduce expression quickly.

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 9 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 12 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total capacity of the cistern = LCM of 9 and 12 = 36 units.

Combined efficiency of (P + Q) = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 units/hour.

Efficiency of P = 36 ÷ 12 = 3 units/hour.

Efficiency of Q alone = 4 − 3 = 1 unit/hour.

Time taken by Q to fill 1/4 of the cistern = (36 × 1/4) ÷ 1 = 9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 hours.**
